args.title: Investigate Windows CSV line ending / BOM handling in CSV ingest
args.body: Propose inspecting src/ingest/csv.js to investigate the CSV parser column count check, specifically handling of Windows line endings (CRLF) or BOM characters from new accounting export tools that cause row 1 column mismatch errors.
